label: Mixamo (mixamorig:* prefix)
_handednessNote: Mixamo's 'Left*' bones are on the character's physical LEFT; code's leftArm is the character's left. Runner-pack clips (Basic Shooter / Pistol / Rifle 8-Way locomotion) author the gun in mixamorig:RightHand — so we map RightHand → rightArm.wrist, gun gets parented to rightArm.wrist via state.handedness='right', and the clip pose lines up with the gameplay-attached weapon. Earlier flipped mapping (Left→rightArm) was a procgen-clip-on-mixamo-bone convention that no live code path depends on now.
_bonePrefixStripNote: Three.js's GLTFLoader sanitizes glTF node names by stripping colons, so a bone authored as 'mixamorig:Hips' lands in the scene graph as 'mixamorigHips'. We try both prefixes here so the lookup works whether the asset went through GLB export (no colon) or FBX directly (with colon).
